text:
Lee H: Heads up — prod deploy failing for the morning rollout. Deploy bot errors out with 403 / signer key not found. Looks like the service account key rotated at ~06:12 UTC and the deployer process can't sign.
deploy-bot: release 2026-03-20-7b3a: ERROR step=sign-image status=403 unauthorized: signer key not found
Amanda T: Which SA is that? Is it the auto-rotated one from KMS? @Carol S can you confirm?
Lee H: It's `redwood-deployer-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Rotation event id `rot-2026-03-20-0612` in audit log.
Raj P: If the key rotated and the deployer is still trying to use the old one, short-term is to let a human impersonate or grant the deployer user a temporary permission to impersonate that SA.
Carol S: Security note — prefer using service account impersonation instead of adding long-lived keys. We can grant `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` to the person doing the deploy for 15m. Example command to grant token creator:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding redwood-deployer-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member="user:raj@redwood.com" \
  --role="roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
```
Lee H: I don't have that permission. Can @sre-oncall or @Raj P do the grant? We need to either unblock this deploy or roll back to the previous stable artifact (v1.14.2) — current target commit 7b3a.
sre-oncall: I'm oncall. I can do a one-off grant but per policy MFA is required for any breakglass. Need an approval in thread from an eng lead or product owner.
Amanda T: I'm +1 on emergency exception to restore production. Raj, can you coordinate? I approve for 15 minutes.
Raj P: On it. Will grant impersonation for 15m, trigger the deploy-bot retry, then revoke. Adding an audit note and INC ticket.
Raj P: running grant now — will post audit link once done.
deploy-bot: retry queued for release 2026-03-20-7b3a by Raj P
Lee H: If retry works, please pin pipeline to v1.14.2 as fallback in the CD config so the next automated attempt doesn't try the rotated key path. Also prioritize adding a preflight that checks SA key validity.
sre-oncall: Grant completed. Ticket INC-4582 created. MFA audit recorded (exception flagged). Temporary binding expires in 15m.
Amanda T: :thumbsup: keep us posted on rollout status.
deploy-bot: rollout complete. status=success id=rl-20260320-7b3a-001 duration=3m42s
Lee H: Great — thanks Raj and oncall. Follow-ups: 1) remove reliance on long-lived keys for deployer 2) add scheduled reminders for key rotations to eng-releases channel (7 days/1 day) 3) add deploy-bot preflight that checks service-account token generation.
Carol S: Agreed. I'll open a ticket for automated reminders and update the security runbook for breakglass grants. Also let's add a config option to pin artifact in the pipeline to avoid accidental forward rollouts during infra churn.
Lee H: Filing the postmortem and action items now. Closing thread once tickets are in place.
Amanda T: Thanks everyone!
